reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(a.impressions) AS impressions
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
), rates AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT channel_id, spend_date,
    100.0 * clicks / impressions AS ctr,
    100.0 * SUM(clicks) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 7 DAY PRECEDING AND INTERVAL 1 DAY PRECEDING)
      / SUM(impressions) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 7 DAY PRECEDING AND INTERVAL 1 DAY PRECEDING) AS ctr_prev_7d
  FROM daily
)
SELECT channel_id, spend_date, ROUND(ctr, 2) AS ctr_pct, ROUND(ctr_prev_7d, 2) AS ctr_prev_7d_pct
FROM rates
WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  AND ctr < 0.9 * ctr_prev_7d

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(a.impressions) AS impressions
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
), sums AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT channel_id, spend_date, clicks, impressions,
    SUM(clicks) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 7 DAY PRECEDING AND INTERVAL 1 DAY PRECEDING) AS clicks_prev_7d,
    SUM(impressions) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 7 DAY PRECEDING AND INTERVAL 1 DAY PRECEDING) AS impressions_prev_7d
  FROM daily
)
SELECT channel_id, spend_date, ROUND(100.0 * clicks / impressions, 2) AS ctr_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * clicks_prev_7d / impressions_prev_7d, 2) AS ctr_prev_7d_pct
FROM sums
WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  AND 100.0 * clicks / impressions < 0.9 * (100.0 * clicks_prev_7d / impressions_prev_7d)

  WHERE d.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'

other_way.tradeoff: Joining each day to the channel's 7 days before it adds up the same clicks and impressions, but the join holds a week of rows per day.
